runtime_pipeline.meaning: Submit objective; interface owns no execution authority.
Resolve durable project intent and affected structural owner before mutation.
Expose bounded project context, capabilities and evidence expectations without granting authority.
Interpret, investigate, plan, choose exposed capabilities and propose actions.
Validate requested capability and typed arguments.
ALLOW, DENY, or explicit authority expansion decision before execution.
Execute only inside the governed authority boundary.
Record operation identity, results, diffs/hashes/output and provenance.
Continue reasoning over governed results without becoming execution authority.
Evidence decides completion; provider prose cannot manufacture terminal truth.
Project canonical truth without becoming a second runtime authority.
